title: Grok Sandbox Custom Profiles
description: `~/.grok/sandbox.toml` (global) and `<workspace>/.grok/sandbox.toml` (project) — a map of custom sandbox profile name to `ProfileConfig`, under `[profiles.<name>]`. Only CUSTOM profile names live here; the five built-ins (`workspace` default, `devbox`, `read-only`/`readonly`, `strict`, `off`/`none`) are code-resolved and never looked up in this table. `load_sandbox_config` loads the global file first as the base `SandboxConfig`, then merges the project file ADDITIVELY ONLY (`config.profiles.entry(name).or_insert(profile)`) — a project file CANNOT redefine or override a profile name already present in the global file; this prevents a workspace from hollowing out a trusted custom profile while keeping its name. `deny` paths are kernel-enforced (read + write/rename) on both platforms regardless of which base profile was extended.

profiles.description: `#[serde(default)] HashMap<String, ProfileConfig>` on `SandboxConfig` — the sole field; the TOML table key under `[profiles.<name>]` is the custom profile's name (referenced elsewhere as `extends = "<name>"` or a sandbox-profile CLI selection resolving to `ProfileName::Custom(name)`).

profileConfig.description: `struct ProfileConfig` — all five fields are optional/defaulted; no `rename_all`, no aliases, literal snake_case TOML keys.

extends.description: Base built-in profile this custom profile extends, resolved via `ProfileName::from_str`. `#[serde(default)] Option<String>`; absent (`None`) defaults to extending `workspace`. DEPTH-1 ONLY: the base must be one of the four non-`off` built-ins (`workspace`/`devbox`/`read-only` — `readonly` is an accepted alias spelling with no hyphen — /`strict`); `extends = "off"`/`"none"` is a HARD ERROR (`bail!`), and naming ANOTHER custom profile is also a hard error — custom profiles cannot chain-extend other custom profiles. The resolved base's `read_only`/`read_write`/`deny`/`default_read`/`restrict_network` seed this profile before this profile's own overrides (below) are applied.

restrict_network.description: When `Some(_)`, REPLACES (not merges with) the resolved base profile's `restrict_network` value; when `None`/absent, the base's value is kept as-is. `#[serde(default)] Option<bool>`.

read_only.description: Extra read-only paths APPENDED onto (not replacing) the resolved base profile's `read_only` list. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>`.

read_write.description: Extra read-write paths APPENDED onto (not replacing) the resolved base profile's `read_write` list. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>`.

deny.description: Extra denied paths APPENDED onto (not replacing) the resolved base profile's `deny` list; kernel-enforced (read + write/rename) on both platforms on top of the base profile, regardless of which base was extended. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>`.
